sources.quote: Dimensions: 301 mm (W) x 182 mm (D) x 78 mm (H)

Interfaces: Controller Port x 2 MEMORY CARD slot x 2 USB connector x 2 (*) EXPANSION BAY x 1 AV MULTI OUT connector x 1 DIGITAL OUT (OPTICAL) connector x 1 (This model does not include i.LINK (IEEE 1394) connector)
opening and closing of disk tray
a new model of its PlayStation®2 computer entertainment system

notes: Sony's 2003-04-14 release (English, sonyinteractive.com press-release archive). Axes labelled (W/D/H): width 301, depth 182, height 78; 'Approximately 2kg' recorded as 2000 g.

ports = the release's Interfaces row, complete (and it states the i.LINK connector was dropped). The controller connector is Sony's own (Sony names it 'Controller port' / コントローラ端子 and no standard); it is filed as controller_proprietary. Sony's table says 'USB' without naming the receptacle; it is filed as usb_a, the only USB receptacle in the §3 vocabulary before USB-C, and the reader should treat the A as Sony-unstated. Sony's input/output row does not list the AC inlet, so ports has no power_in item; that absence is Sony's table, not a statement that the console has no inlet. features.power_inlet stays null.
media: the release's own wording names the console's disk tray (the new DVD remote can open and close it); one media interface.
Wikidata has no model-level item for SCPH-50000; external_ids left null.
